publishableKey.description: The installation's publishable (anon) key. No session bearer accompanies a public request.

sessionBearer.description: A signed-in session on the TARGET installation. It names the account; SQL decides what it may do.

PublicContact.description: An owner, or an administrator who opted into public visibility. user_id is an account reference published only so a participant can open a conversation; it grants nothing.

PublicWorkspaceDocument.description: The projection the owner approved for public display, plus the workspace name, currency, booking unit and consenting contacts. No invitation code, plan, occupancy, price, internal note or operator stamp.

must_understand.description: Terms the reader must understand; an unknown one refuses the record.

PublicationInput.description: What the owner may write. Exactly the keys save_workspace_public_page accepts; every value is a string. An inherited field (host_type, address) that is absent follows the workspace's own information (#2086); a present one, even blank, overrides it.

PublicationDraft.description: The owner's own page as the editor reads it back, published or not. Management output: every field optional, an unsaved page is empty.

PublicationPage.description: Whether the page is published, its draft with every inherited field resolved, and which inherited fields follow the workspace information.

PublicationFollowing.description: Per inherited public field: true while it follows the workspace's own information, false once the owner overrode it (#2086).
